exam: BC Construction Electrician (Red Seal / Certificate of Qualification)

blocks.A: Performs common occupational skills (safety, tools, organising, support components, commissioning, communication)
blocks.B: Installs/services/maintains generating, distribution and service systems (services & metering, protection devices, distribution, UPS/surge, bonding & grounding, generation, renewables, high-voltage, transformers)
blocks.C: Installs/services/maintains wiring systems (raceways/cables/enclosures, branch circuitry, HVAC, electric heating, exit/emergency lighting, cathodic protection)
blocks.D: Installs/services/maintains motor and control systems (starters & controls, drives, motors, automated control)
blocks.E: Installs/services/maintains signalling and communication systems (signalling, communication, integrated control)
